external_process_watch.scope: Untimed external build/test/runtime activity is recorded without certifying timing. Healthy scanners, actual outputs, owned cleanup and exact input hashes remain mandatory. Timed phases reject every build/test/runtime overlap; no dormant exemption.
external_process_watch.limit: A short-lived external process entirely between one-second snapshots may be missed.
